intro.text: A wide, flat stretch of land, which some people in Mountaincrest simply call the plains.
A wide, flat, forested land south of Mountaincrest, where the River Violet comes to an end. Some in Mountaincrest simply call it the plains.

description.text: The plains are in effect one great flat forest. The River Violet, one of the blood rivers, flows onto them and slowly evaporates at its end, known as the terminus. Many-armed demons called walkers, often more than twenty feet tall, roam there.

Many nomadic tribes and clans live there. Mountaincrest dismisses them as savages, but they are far more civilized than that reputation. They trade with the north, above all in textiles, speak their own language, use camels or similar beasts and keep slaves.

The nomads both worship and bind the great demons. Each clan has Inspirers who deal with them, from initiates up to a head Inspirer. Their society is rigidly ordered, and only some of its rules shield them from the demons. They are pragmatic, caring little where someone comes from if they get results.

items.text: The plains were once the home of humanity, until the devastation that came with the Megalith drove many people north.

In the second life December lived through, the plains peoples took in many refugees from Mountaincrest. December lived among them for years and became an Inspirer, rising to head Inspirer of her clan before the Megalith came and wiped out the plains peoples.
Back in her own life, December sent hexers who wished to learn witchcraft south to the plains peoples.
